about: How render.library.appearance.apply's graph variant binds a starter surface (SURF-*) or a Selene appearance (SELENE-AP-*) that has a direction: its specular anisotropy and the rotation of its tangent from the projection's u axis. Every amount is an authored estimate from the recipe's pattern and the direction its roughness map varies least in, not a measured BRDF. Entries not listed are isotropic (0).

surfaces.note: cross-brushed: two crossing directions, which one tangent cannot express; drawn isotropic
turning marks along u; on a turned part they run around its axis only when a frame lays u along the circumference
brushed under an anodic layer: lines along u, softened
printed top-skin lines along the u-v diagonal

selene_appearances.note: concentric toolmarks need an axis, which a planar or triplanar tangent lacks; drawn isotropic
linear brushing along the projection's u
directional machining along the projection's u
concentric finish needs an axis; drawn isotropic
directional finish along the projection's u
extrusion lines along the projection's u
thread marks run around an axis; drawn isotropic
